title: NEWS_INTELLIGENCE_EXPANSION_NOAPI
source_of_truth: ERA35 selected work unit plan and repository/server state after ERA35 closure at 92f8228f46e5a48d51bbe1fd88bb8c94609d1c9f
purpose: Expand News Intelligence from narrow token matching into passive narrative, risk and opportunity intelligence without runtime mutation, wallet access, trading, or external API execution in this phase.

known_problem.known_issue: Matcher returns zero because token_score_100_events lacks name/symbol/address.
known_problem.architecture_gap: News Intelligence must not be limited to DEX token matching; narrative, opportunity and risk layers are required.

allowed_work_in_era36: Separate token identity matching from broader narrative intelligence.
Define readmodel outputs for future panel consumption.
forbidden_work_in_era36: Do not execute external API calls.
Do not mutate live news runtime.
Do not create wallet, trade, order, signing or live execution logic.
Do not create new canonical root files.

artifact_policy.control_location: data/control/ only if selector/control artifact is needed

success_criteria: News expansion is contractually separated from trade decisions.
Token identity provider boundary is defined before matcher repair.
Narrative, risk and opportunity layers are defined as passive intelligence only.
No external API/runtime mutation occurs in this phase.
ERA36 can hand off to a later implementation phase safely.
